description: Plan a weekly buy of a stock token on Robinhood Chain for `wallet`: `usd` or `eth` each week on `weekday` at `hour` in `tz`. Nothing is bought or signed now. The plan starts only after the wallet’s owner confirms it at https://keyfo.xyz/app, signed in with that wallet. At each time keyfo prepares a fresh trade and a sign link; the owner signs it in their own wallet within 6 hours, or that buy is marked missed and the plan goes on. Limits: 5 plans per wallet, $500 per buy, $1000 a week per wallet.

eth.description: ETH to spend on each buy. Give usd or eth, not both.
eth.title: Eth

hour.description: Hour of the day in tz, from 0 to 23.
hour.title: Hour

token.description: Ticker, like NVDA, or the token address.
token.title: Token

tz.description: IANA time zone, like Europe/Kyiv or America/New_York. UTC by default.
tz.title: Tz

usd.description: Dollars of ETH to spend on each buy, at the ETH price at that time. Up to 500.
usd.title: Usd

wallet.description: The wallet that buys and signs. Its owner confirms the plan at https://keyfo.xyz/app.
wallet.title: Wallet

weekday.description: Day of the week: monday to sunday.
weekday.title: Weekday
